data.name: AlFarhan
data.gender_notes: AlFarhan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'faraha' meaning 'to be joyful' or 'to give joy'. AlFarhan is a name that brings happiness and blessings. It is a name that is given to a child who is expected to spread joy and positivity around him. The name AlFarhan carries the meaning “The Giver of Glad Tidings” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose AlFarhan usually hope their child will grow to embody the giver of glad tidings and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: AlFarhan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Giver of Glad Tidings.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of AlFarhan total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
